stem: A student graphed f(x) = x and g(x) = f(x) + 3 on the same coordinate grid. Which statement describes how the graphs of f and g are related?

options.label: A
options.text: The graph of f is shifted 3 units up to create the graph of g.

options.label: B
options.text: The graph of f is steeper than the graph of g.

options.label: C
options.text: The graph of f is shifted 3 units down to create the graph of g.

options.label: D
options.text: The graph of f is less steep than the graph of g.
